newsitem.title: USA: IBM licenses Microware OS-9 system.
newsitem.headline: IBM licenses Microware OS-9 system.

text.p: Microware Systems Corp said Monday that International Business Machines Corp has licensed the OS-9 real-time operating system from Microware.
The company said IBM plans to use the technology in products aimed at manufacturers of a variety of wireless and wired Internet- and Intranet-access devices.

"Being chosen as one of the potential operating systems in IBM's OEM network computer technology demonstrates that Microware has a proven and reliable operating system in OS-9," said Ken Kaplan, president and CEO of Microware.

OEM is industry jargon that refers to computer makers that build products based on IBM's design for its new line of "network computers," a scaled-down, diskless type of computer used to connect to corporate networks and the Internet.
OS-9 is a real-time operating system that fits in a wide range of computers from small handheld devices to large networked systems.
